agent.reasons: The entity is located in Iran (IR), and so are all the identified individuals. Iran is a comprehensively sanctioned country, so SOP 6.1 requires a decline, and under 2.1 the most severe outcome governs. Every other check is clear: the registry filing (2025-11-16) is under 12 months old, all 20%+ owners are identified and verified (through Meridian, Omar Yilmaz holds about 18.4% and Umar Petrov about 4.6%), the control person is identified, and screening found no sanctions, PEP or adverse media hits.
